why: The brief already fixes the invariants, so the long run proceeds without a pause. Done means a 20-step run whose model context stays bounded, a crash resume that does not repeat a finished non-idempotent tool, and the existing suite still green.

decision: AI has no public one-tool executor, so the runtime cannot call tool procs directly
why: Validation, authorization, confirmation, timeout, and result limits live only inside CustomToolExecution, which generate uses after a model tool call.
